The True Cost Over 20 Years

An implant from £2,950 can last 20+ years with proper care and maintenance†. A bridge from £750 typically needs replacing every 10-15 years. A denture from £500 needs replacing every 5-7 years plus relines. Implants may be more cost-effective long-term.

Pricing Factors

What Affects Dental Implant Cost?

Several factors influence the final price of your treatment. Here's what determines your personalised quote.

Crown Material

Zirconia crowns are more durable and aesthetic than porcelain-fused-to-metal options.

Complexity

Common Questions

Dental Implant Cost FAQs

Why are dental implants more expensive than dentures or bridges?
Dental implants require surgical placement of a titanium post into the jawbone, custom-made crowns, and expert care. While the upfront cost is higher, published research suggests implants can provide many years of reliable function with proper care, compared to shorter lifespans for some alternatives. They also help support bone structure, which may reduce future costs associated with bone loss and ill-fitting dentures.
Do you offer payment plans?
Yes, we offer 0% finance over 12 months as well as extended payment plans up to 5 years (subject to status). We work with reputable medical finance providers to make implants accessible to everyone.
What finance options do you offer?
We offer 0% interest finance for up to 12 months, and extended payment plans up to 60 months (subject to status). A single tooth implant from £2,950 can be spread across monthly payments of around £123/month over 24 months. We also accept all major credit cards. Finance is subject to status.
What's included in your implant prices?
Our prices are fully inclusive with no hidden costs. Single tooth implant (from £2,950) includes: consultation, X-rays, CT scan, the titanium implant, healing abutment, custom zirconia crown, all follow-up appointments, and a 5-year warranty. The only additional cost would be if bone grafting is required.
Why do dental implant prices vary so much between clinics?
Prices vary based on: implant quality (we use premium dental implants with zirconia crowns), dentist expertise and training, lab fees for custom crowns, clinic location and facilities, and what's included in the quote. Beware of very low prices that may use inferior implants or exclude essential components.
Is it worth going abroad for cheaper implants?
While dental tourism may seem cheaper, consider: travel costs, accommodation, time off work, no continuity of care, difficulty with follow-ups or complications, variable regulatory standards, and no UK-based warranty. Many patients come to us to fix problems from overseas treatment, which costs more in the long run.
